pins.name: GPIO12
pins.label: GPIO12 (Button)
pins.notes:
SWITCH_A — onboard general-purpose pushbutton ("switch between effects" per shop.pimoroni.com). Not declared via static-const alias in this board's own pins_arduino.h (PIN_SWITCH_A is #define-only); confirmed via shop.pimoroni.com product copy and independently via the matthew-mccall/pico-sdk-plasma2350-w third-party board header (SW_A_PIN=12). No diode-isolation or other special-circuitry caveat documented anywhere.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO14
pins.label: GPIO14
pins.notes:
CLK — screw-terminal clock line for external APA102/Dotstar LED strip output. Not declared at all in this board's own pins_arduino.h (no PIN_ alias); confirmed general-purpose GPIO via direct analogy to the already-audited non-WiFi pimoroni_plasma2040/pimoroni_plasma2350 siblings (identical GPIO14/rp-hal-boards-sourced finding) and independently via the matthew-mccall/pico-sdk-plasma2350-w third-party board header (CLK_PIN=14). No strip-specific capability tag — drives an external user-attached strip, not board-owned hardware.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO15
pins.label: GPIO15
pins.notes:
DAT — this board's own pins_arduino.h PIN_NEOPIXEL(15) alias, but despite the name it drives the EXTERNAL WS2812/Neopixel + APA102/Dotstar strip screw terminal, not an onboard NeoPixel (confirmed on the non-WiFi siblings and independently via the matthew-mccall/pico-sdk-plasma2350-w third-party board header, DATA_PIN=15). No led_neopixel tag — that tag is reserved for a board's own onboard addressable LED, which this pin is not.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO16
pins.label: GPIO16 (Led Red active low)
pins.notes:

pins.name: GPIO22
pins.label: GPIO22 (Button)
pins.notes:
SWITCH_USER — doubles as the BOOT-select switch, confirmed usable as a plain user button per shop.pimoroni.com/adafruit.com/pishop.us ("the BOOT button can also be used as a user button") and matching the non-WiFi siblings' already-confirmed USER_SW treatment (full capability, no diode-isolation caveat documented — this is an ordinary software-polled GPIO, not the true QSPI-flash BOOTSEL silicon line). Independently confirmed via the matthew-mccall/pico-sdk-plasma2350-w third-party board header (USER_SW_PIN=22).
Check if available on board

pins.name: MOSI
pins.label: MOSI (GPIO24)
pins.notes: PIN_SPI0_MISO/PIN_SPI0_MOSI (shared single data line) — CONFIRMED wired internally to the CYW43439/RM2 wireless module's own gSPI control bus, NOT a user-accessible SPI0 peripheral, per this board's own "wired to wifi module" comment, this file's own SPI_HOWMANY (0u) declaration, and the matthew-mccall/pico-sdk-plasma2350-w third-party board header's exact-match "Data in/out: 24" WiFi-pin documentation. Capabilities intentionally left as this project's default alias-derived set (not overridden) because this board's own pins_arduino.h declares a LIVE `static const uint8_t MOSI/MISO = ...` alias here — confirmed byte-for-byte identical to the real, actively-compiled upstream arduino-pico core file, so build_boards.js's spi_mosi/spi_miso auto-append cannot be suppressed via chipGpios (it fires unconditionally whenever consts.MOSI/MISO resolves to this GPIO, regardless of any capabilities override here) without editing that live pin-assignment code, which is out of scope for this Designer/pin-database audit. Sketches for this board should avoid using this GPIO.

pins.name: SS
pins.label: SS (GPIO25)
pins.notes: PIN_SPI0_SS — CONFIRMED wired internally to the CYW43439/RM2 wireless module's own gSPI chip-select line, NOT a user-accessible SPI0 peripheral, per this board's own SPI_HOWMANY (0u) declaration and the matthew-mccall/pico-sdk-plasma2350-w third-party board header's exact-match "Chip select: 25" WiFi-pin documentation. Same rationale as GPIO24 for why no capabilities override is applied here — the live static-const SS alias in this board's own (real, upstream-identical) pins_arduino.h makes build_boards.js's spi_ss auto-append unavoidable via board.json alone. Sketches for this board should avoid using this GPIO.

pins.name: SCK
pins.label: SCK (GPIO29)
pins.notes: PIN_SPI0_SCK — CONFIRMED wired internally to the CYW43439/RM2 wireless module's own gSPI clock line (also this board's already-excluded current-sense-only A3 candidate, per the pre-existing pfodWeb NOTE beside the Analog pins block and the matthew-mccall/pico-sdk-plasma2350-w third-party board header's exact-match "Clock: 29" WiFi-pin documentation, corroborated by its separate "Current sense: 29" note). Same rationale as GPIO24/25 for why no capabilities override is applied here — the live static-const SCK alias in this board's own (real, upstream-identical) pins_arduino.h makes build_boards.js's spi_sck auto-append unavoidable via board.json alone. Sketches for this board should avoid using this GPIO.
